selection_reasoning: These four tasks form a coherent multi-hop sequence centered around wood-related exploration and construction. The player must first locate a dark oak door (which serves as a landmark/structure), then mine dark oak leaves nearby (the door implies a dark oak structure with leaves). The player must also mine birch wood (gathering building material). Finally, with gathered resources and cleared space from mining, the player builds a wall. The dependency structure has two parallel branches (find door → mine leaves, and mine birch wood) that converge into the final building task. This tests navigation, resource gathering, and construction in sequence.

edges.reason: Dark oak leaves are located near the dark oak door structure; player must find the door first to locate the leaves
Mining leaves clears space adjacent to the structure where the wall must be built
Birch wood logs are the building material needed to construct the wall

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate to the dark oak door on the west face of the structure and face it. The doors are at spawn-relative (5, 0-1, 5-6). Target is set to (5, 1, 5) — the upper half of one door. max_distance=5 ensures the player actually walks toward it rather than triggering from spawn. facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at the door.

Uses count_in_box_at_most because mining dark_oak_leaves with a diamond axe does NOT reliably drop the leaves item (requires silk touch or shears). Therefore inventory_has is unreliable. Instead, we verify at least 1 leaf block was removed from the canopy. The canopy has exactly 40 dark_oak_leaves blocks in the box (4,3,3)-(9,4,8). Setting max_count=39 means at least 1 must have been mined.

Uses inventory_has because mining birch_wood blocks with a diamond axe drops birch_wood items directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with NO birch_wood in inventory (only birch_planks), so having at least 1 birch_wood confirms successful mining.

Uses count_in_box_at_least because this is a build/place task. The player must place birch_planks blocks to form a wall on or near the stone brick foundation at spawn-relative z=10. A generous box (-4, 0, 7) to (4, 4, 13) captures any reasonable wall placement near the foundation. min_count=3 requires at least 3 blocks placed to constitute a minimal wall structure.

scene_description: A flat smooth stone platform with a dark oak plank structure (4x4x5 blocks) featuring two dark oak doors on the west face and dark oak leaves forming a canopy at y+3 and y+4. Three birch_wood columns (4 blocks tall) stand to the west. A stone brick line at z+10 marks the wall building area. The player spawns with a diamond axe and 20 birch planks. Natural dark oak forest biome surrounds the cleared area but does not interfere with task completion.
task_text: Find the dark oak door on the structure, mine some dark oak leaves from its canopy, mine birch wood from the columns to the west, then build a wall using birch planks on the stone brick foundation behind you.
design_notes: Coordinates: Dark oak structure at (~5-8, 0-4, ~4-7) with doors at (~5, 0-1, ~5-6). Leaves canopy at (~4-9, 3-4, ~3-8) minus inner area. Birch wood columns at (~-6, 0-3, ~3), (~-7, 0-3, ~5), (~-5, 0-3, ~6). Building foundation at (~-2 to ~2, 0, ~10). Leaves at y+3 are reachable by jumping. Player has diamond axe for mining and 20 birch planks for building.
